note: Skeptical-researcher angle. Fresh context only; findings judged against the North Star. Process-only nits that do not threaten a North-Star criterion are omitted or demoted.

findings.topic: open/run missing from inventory and waves
findings.criterion: On branch v1.2, John can open, run, stop, and restart real Anchor work
findings.message: The North Star leads with open and run. W3's control list (Retry, Diagnose, restart per context, stop-summary, preview, projects-collapse, cadence, per-engine diagnose) never inventories open or run. No Phase-3 wave delivers, traces, or gates either verb. Stop/restart/attach/Doctor get full surface treatment; open and run are assumed pre-existing and only reappear as strings in the W1 task triple and the W21 S1 script. A plan that can go GREEN through W20 without a single PRESENT/STUB/ABSENT verdict or end-to-end trace for open/run cannot claim the leading clause of the North Star is engineered—only hoped for at S1.

findings.criterion: silent zero; mislabelled empty; unknown ≠ empty ≠ zero; usage either works end-to-end or fails with a named state
findings.message: W4 states that a usage rollup query returning zero rows is UNPROVEN, forces an aggregation wave, and registers the surface as pending—not 0 and not blank. That collapses three distinct research outcomes into one: (a) no aggregator/table exists, (b) aggregator exists and correctly returns empty for the window, (c) measured zero. W11 later requires a PROVEN rollup that returns zero rows today to render empty, distinct from unknown and zero_measured. Those two gates cannot both be true under the same evidence rule. As written, the rollup gate will systematically mislabel legitimate empty/zero periods as "pending aggregation," which is exactly the mislabelled-empty / silent-zero class the North Star forbids—only with a different confident wrong label.

findings.topic: captured-once transcript as live capability proof
findings.criterion: every surface that claims health, usage, or diagnose either works end-to-end or fails with a named, user-visible state; no dead control
findings.message: CAPABILITY-INVENTORY is the gate that decides what surface waves may claim, yet evidence is "captured-once, replayed-many" transcripts so John is not needed live to re-run a probe. That is a convenience design that fails as science: a PRESENT verdict from a frozen transcript does not prove the control is still wired when W10–W19 ship; a STUB transcript from seed output can be fixed in code while the inventory still says STUB (or the reverse). There is no re-probe obligation, staleness bound, or hash-link from inventory row to the code under test at surface-wave time. Surface waves can therefore render "working" against an obsolete capability claim—or skip a real build because an old PRESENT was replayed. For dead-control and E2E honesty, inventory-as-snapshot is not inventory-as-evidence.

findings.section: Wave 6 NamedState; Hardening-gate obligations (failure-state table vocabulary); wave-local failure-states/*
findings.criterion: unknown ≠ empty ≠ zero; every surface fails with a named, user-visible state
findings.message: The plan simultaneously asserts (1) NamedState enum {ok, unknown, empty, zero_measured, pending, unmeasured, measurement_failed, timeout, cannot_retry} as the single render primitive, and (2) the journal-0080 five-row vocabulary {dependency-missing, dependency-slow-or-killed, dependency-returns-garbage, backing-store-unreadable, empty-but-valid} with status code + user-visible text per surface verb. Wave-local tables only promise "unknown and empty as separate rows." There is no mapping table, no requirement that each of the five 0080 rows appear in each surface file, and no test that a dependency-returns-garbage path cannot render as empty or zero. The hardening section says a claim without a matching obligation is a BLOCKER; here both schemas are claimed and neither is forced into the other. Conformance can pass tri-state fixtures while the five required honesty rows are never exercised—leaving the confident-wrong-answer class unenforced.

findings.section: Waves 10–19 done-when / Intent; Wave 21; North Star S1 clause
findings.criterion: Steward conversational proof is a post-build validation session (S1), not a silent claim of this build
findings.message: Wave intents repeatedly say "Close criterion N" (attach, usage, cost, Doctor, stop/restart, preview, projects, cadence) on the basis of scoped pytest, fault injectors, and generated HTML. W21 correctly blocks the unqualified North Star string until S1, but the plan still treats structural GREEN as criterion closure for ten criteria before any live open/run/stop/restart/Doctor/attach session with John. That is a silent claim of build success by another name: the status string is careful; the wave contract language is not. A skeptical researcher reads "close criterion 4" after W13 as a knowledge claim the evidence design forbids until S1. Either waves must say "structurally candidate only; criterion remains open until S1" with freeze/traceability reflecting that, or S1 must be an intermediate gate before any "closed" stamp—not only a terminal ceremony.

findings.topic: task triple omits Doctor and attach
findings.criterion: including Doctor diagnose and session attach; open, run, stop, and restart
findings.message: The hard-blocking evidence floor is a three-task triple: open / run / stop-restart. Doctor diagnose and session attach—named in the North Star in the same breath—are not in the triple, not John-confirmed at Phase 0, and only appear in the S1 script at the end. Phase 1 inventory may list Diagnose and Retry, but the reproducible verification tasks John signs do not. The research design therefore front-loads evidence for a subset of the North Star and postpones the attach/Doctor half until after all surface waves claim readiness. That is selection bias in the verification sample: the tasks that are easiest to schedule as "confirmation lines" are not the full phenomenon under test.

The plan hinges dollar honesty on a cost spot-check that, if wrong, forces measurement_failed and blocks E2. It never specifies the population (which engines, which window), the independent source-row sum procedure, the agreement tolerance, who may not compute both sides, or what sample size constitutes a check versus an anecdote. Without a replicable protocol, "disagrees with the source rows" is an unfalsifiable gate: any convenient pair of numbers can pass or fail. Cost fabrication can then survive as an under-specified check that tests assert exists, not that dollars are true.

findings.topic: diagnose reality tested only by output variation
findings.criterion: Doctor diagnose; surfaces that claim diagnose work end-to-end or fail named
findings.message: "Real diagnosis" is proven by: two induced faults produce different rendered findings, non-canned output, and banner payload presence. That refutes only the weakest straw man (identical hard-coded string). It does not refute a multi-branch stub that maps fault-inject tags to polished text, nor prove findings correspond to independent ground truth outside the injector. Banner payload "not re-derived from scratch" is asserted without defining what re-derivation looks like in the artifact. For a skeptical researcher, variation under a co-located fault harness is not end-to-end diagnose honesty on real Anchor work—the North Star's Doctor clause.

findings.topic: unproven rollup has no forced aggregation wave
findings.criterion: 3 rollups remain UNPROVEN, and W11 accepts permanent labelled pending as success for those tiles. Named pending is better than silent zero, but the North Star also requires that surfaces that claim usage either work end-to-end or fail named—not that they may forever claim usage while only showing pending. Without a freeze-time rule (aggregate-or-remove-claim) or a hard cap on pending-as-GO, the plan can "meet" criterion 3 by never measuring usage at all.
findings.message: UNPROVEN rollups "require" an aggregation wave and freeze/amendment procedure, but no wave is pre-allocated, no freeze rule forbids stamping while

findings.criterion: no preview that dumps raw binary; file preview human-friendly
findings.message: W17's entire strategy is "reuse the already-working new-window renderer" for docx/pptx/xlsx/pdf. W3 inventories a "preview path" but the plan never requires a PRESENT transcript of that shared path before W17, nor a STUB→build-it branch if the path is theater. "Already-working" is an untested premise. If the shared path is missing, partial, or itself dumps binary for one format, the wave's fixtures can still pass against a mock while production preview remains the raw-binary failure mode the North Star names.

findings.section: Success criteria; Wave 13 banner_handoff; Wave 19 cadence
findings.criterion: Every surface that claims health, usage, or diagnose either works end-to-end or fails with a named, user-visible state
findings.message: Health is named alongside usage and diagnose in the North Star. The plan covers diagnose deeply and cadence/status as "status," but the health banner is only a payload handoff into Doctor—not a surface wave with PROVEN data, tri-state fixtures, or failure-state table for the banner's own health claim. A banner that shows confident green/red from unproven or empty inputs is a health surface lying while Doctor is honest. There is no wave that inventories, gates, or traces "claims health" the way W11/W12 gate usage/cost.

findings.criterion: Projects collapsed by default; preference remembered (success criteria supporting open/run UX without mislabelled empty); honesty of stored state
findings.message: W18 claims per-user collapse preference that survives reload across two profiles, with a named unknown state when the store is unreadable. The hardening section requires atomic temp+fsync+rename, cross-process lock or documented serialization, and concurrency tests when durability is claimed. W18 deliverables name none of these, and no repeat-invocation or two-process test appears in its GWT. Dual-profile tests can pass on a racy or partially written store that later surfaces as wrong expanded/collapsed state—mislabelled empty/unknown relative to what the user actually chose—without tripping any stated gate.

findings.topic: property gates asserted without wave enforcement
findings.criterion: unknown ≠ empty ≠ zero; no dead control / silent zero (honesty property); containment of v1.1.x shipping risk where escape paths matter
findings.message: The plan marks honesty, idempotence, boundedness, and containment as "asserted by this plan," and states that a named property without a checklist entry—or a claim without a matching obligation—is a BLOCKER. Surface waves do emphasize failure-state files and unknown≠empty. They do not name numeric bounds or refusal paths for inventory reads, rollup row sets, preview bytes, or trace artifacts; almost none state a repeat-invocation idempotence test; containment escape tests are centered on planning/ write smoke, not on preview/path/preference handlers that read user-controlled paths. The checklist is emitted; the wave contracts do not bind it. That is a paper guarantee of the honesty/containment properties the North Star depends on.

findings.topic: dead-control audit only at final sweep
findings.message: Continuous surface work (W10–W19) has no mandatory dead_control_audit; only W20 sweeps. Individual waves hide Retry/Diagnose when unavailable, but dual competing restart controls, leftover dead buttons on non-focal surfaces, and regressions introduced while fixing another criterion are only global-audited after all criteria claim closure. That is late detection for the primary North Star defect class. Not a missing feature—timing of the only global proof.

findings.topic: E2 provisional counts still render numerals
findings.criterion: silent zero; every usage surface works end-to-end or fails with a named state; (cost half correctly bans E2 for dollars)
findings.message: W2 correctly forbids E2 for dollars. W11 still allows a signed E2 that ships a usage/time numeral with as_of and a reconciliation log entry. A skeptical researcher treats a provisional number next to a small stamp as still a confident quantitative claim—closer to fabricated certainty than to pending/unmeasured—unless the named state machine forbids bare numerals under E2 and forces a provisional-labelled state as the primary visible text. as_of alone does not discharge the silent-wrong-number risk for usage.

Document header says `node scripts/run-all-tests.mjs` while every wave gate is scoped pytest. Inconsistent operator entrypoint; does not by itself create a dead control or fabricated dollar. Demoted under inclusion test.
